technical.summary: ABT shows strong short-term momentum with stochastic and MACD crossovers, but lacks intermediate/long-term trend confirmation and is overbought on Williams %R, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 5 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (neutral AAII, moderate greed) with insufficient news data provides no directional conviction for ABT.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 162 crisis regime, recent CPI miss) combined with critical earnings binary event in 5 days create extreme risk environment for ABT despite falling USD tailwind.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (stochastic/MACD bullish cross, RSI rising) with price near support (96.39) offers defined risk entry for tactical swing trade.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 5 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime (162), zero fundamental conviction, and price below all major moving averages (200-EMA, 50-SMA, Hull MA) create unacceptable risk/reward despite technical setup.
